data.cultural_impact: In Scotland, the name Erskine was associated with the clan of the same name, who were significant landowners and political figures. The clan crest features a pair of stirrup-less horses facing each other, with a wild boar beneath them. This symbolism illustrates the power and strength that the Erskine clan possessed in Scottish society.
